subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should this issue receive a short current-main profiling window, or close because the reported OpenClaw per-connection parsing path is not supported by source or Node's contract?
rationale: The proposed implementation changes ownership of certificate parsing without evidence that OpenClaw currently performs that work, so maintainer judgment is needed on whether further measurement is worth the review cost.

options.title: Allow bounded profiling
options.body: Keep the issue open briefly for a current-main trace showing filesystem-read or certificate-parse call counts during parallel HTTPS requests.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Close the report unless new profiling evidence identifies repeated work in an OpenClaw-owned call path.

recommendation.title: Allow bounded profiling
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open briefly for a current-main trace showing filesystem-read or certificate-parse call counts during parallel HTTPS requests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline routes to this person, who also merged the central CA-bootstrap history changes.
